description:
Before shipping a checkout: checks the renewal disclosure next to the purchase button against every applicable law and returns per-check verdicts with citations plus a verified REPLACEMENT (disclosure_text, consent_label, button_text, drop-in html and jsx).
Pass the text exactly as rendered plus the plan terms. Example: {"text":"Renews monthly at $19.99 until you cancel.","price":19.99,"interval":"month","cancel_url":"https://acme.example/account/cancel","consent":{"checkbox":true,"prechecked":false}}.
If verdict is fail, put replacement.jsx (React) or .html above the button, then call again with the new text, consent and placement.bold: true. needs_review on styling means a rendered scan must confirm.

as_of.description: Evaluate the law as of this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

button_text.description: Purchase button label, e.g. "Start free trial".

cancel_timing.description: When a cancellation takes effect (default period_end).

cancel_url.description: https URL where subscribers cancel online (used in generated text).

interval.description: Billing interval: day, week, month or year (optional with site).

intro_percent_off.description: Or the promo as % off (coupon percent_off).

jurisdictions.description: Where the business sells: "all" (default) or state codes like ["US-CA","US-NY"] ("CA" works too). Federal law is always included.

order_summary.description: Other text next to the button (order summary), if any.

placement.description: Defaults: above the button, same page, 14px, high contrast.

plan.description: With site: plan name or price_…

site.description: site_… whose plans judge it (as verify_task)

text.description: The disclosure shown next to the purchase button, exactly as rendered.

trial_days.description: Free-trial days (0 or absent = no trial).

name: check_disclosure
title: Check checkout disclosure text
